title: Generative AI in Higher Education: The ChatGPT Effect
extended_summary:
This book addresses how generative artificial intelligence, especially ChatGPT, is reshaping higher education. Rather than evaluating a single intervention with participants, it provides a broad conceptual and practical treatment of AI literacy, curriculum design, assessment redesign, policy development, and the technical foundations of generative AI.

The text is organized as a practitioner-oriented guide. It discusses the strengths and weaknesses of ChatGPT and related GenAI tools, offers examples of AI-partnered pedagogy, introduces assessment redesign strategies and an AI assessment integration framework, and outlines principles for developing institutional AI policy. It also includes an overview of the technology behind GenAI and forward-looking discussion of likely impacts on teaching, learning, and research.

The relevant context is higher education, with examples drawn mainly from university teaching, assessment, and policy settings. The authors argue that GenAI should be integrated as a learning partner rather than a replacement for human educators, and they emphasize AI literacy, academic integrity, authenticity, and responsible governance as central themes. The book’s main conclusion is that institutions should adapt pedagogy, assessment, and policy proactively to the GenAI era.
